args.title: Allow quoted column names in statement uploads headers
args.body:
File: src/api/uploads.ts

Currently, statement uploads reject the file if the header row contains quoted column names, causing errors like "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header". This change proposes to adjust the parsing or pre-processing of the header row in the uploading logic to accept column names even if enclosed in quotes, as the transaction lines themselves may have quotes as well. This will fix the issue where the bank export changes to include quoted headers break the upload process.
